children: reported that activist investor Starboard Value has built a significant stake in the company and plans to push for a sale or an improvement in its margins.
Starboard reportedly believes the 2023 spinoff of Knife River
from MDU Resources failed to improve the company's margins and wants the construction company to commit to narrowing the gap between its EBITDA margins and those of its peers in the upcoming years.

Starboard also wants the company to evaluate strategic alternatives including a potential sale, as it believes the business has a high barrier to entry and could be attractive to potential suitors, the report said.
